Pree, I found three Marrow Agrisupply sites named in #central-team:

- **Wichita store** — [Your July 2, 2025 post](https://app.slack.com/archives/C3TT2OEIAJ7/p1751466060000007) mentions an 8 a.m. check-in with the store dispatcher, right after [Tobias’s note about Marrow Agrisupply office hours](https://app.slack.com/archives/C3TT2OEIAJ7/p1751466000000006).
- **Eastbank** — [Hollis’s June 9, 2026 post](https://app.slack.com/archives/C3TT2OEIAJ7/p1781019960000039) cites ticket **PD-4821**: the receiving-door import used E1/E2, but the booking sheet used 01/02.
- **Pine Crossing** — [Your June 9, 2026 post](https://app.slack.com/archives/C3TT2OEIAJ7/p1781020080000040) says the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift.

The [June 9 tracker screenshot discussion](https://app.slack.com/archives/C3TT2OEIAJ7/p1781019840000038) mentions three rows marked “waiting,” but the channel discussion only names Eastbank and Pine Crossing in that rollout. It doesn’t tie Wichita to the third row.
